name: Chlormezanone

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1996 — for serious skin reactions

summary: Chlormezanone was taken off the market worldwide, starting in 1996, because of serious skin reactions [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, it received a low score of 49 for liver concerns [M]. The same computer model also gave it a low score of 48 for heart concerns [M].
